user.title: Staggered Switch
user.description: Define a repeating cycle of days. Actions are addressed as “day N of the cycle” plus a clock time, so a roster can be entered once and will repeat automatically.

data_description.name: Shown on the status sensor and in the entity name.
data_description.anchor_date: Day 1 of the cycle. The schedule repeats every “cycle length” days from here.
data_description.cycle_days: How many days a full cycle lasts, e.g. 8 for an eight day shift roster.

rule.title: When, what and where
rule.description:
Day numbers run from 1 to {cycle_days}.

Pick the entity for *Turn on* / *Turn off*. It can be left empty for *Another service call*.

data_description.day: 1 is the first day of the cycle.
data_description.time: Local time; daylight saving changes are handled automatically.
data_description.service: Turn the entity on, off, or call any service with custom data.
data_description.entity_id: Required for turn on / turn off. Optional for a custom service call.

custom.title: Custom service call
custom.description: Call any Home Assistant service, for example “notify.mobile_app_phone”.

confirm_delete.title: Delete an action
confirm_delete.description: Choose the action to remove. It is deleted when you save.

error.invalid_name: Enter a name of 1 to 64 characters.
error.entity_required: Choose an entity, or pick "Another service call".

abort.too_many_rules: This cycle already has the maximum number of actions.

run_action.name: Run action now

entry_id.description: The staggered switch cycle that owns the action.

rule_index.description: Zero based position of the action in the cycle, as listed by the status sensor.
